comparison.objective: Pick four moving parts from two lanes before their different deadlines and place them in a bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Deadline-aware interception, grasping from servo-driven carriers, and rapid transfer without staging.
comparison.success_condition: Each cube goes directly from its carrier to the bin before passing under the cover; all four still in the bin gives full credit.
comparison.reason: This tests temporal scheduling and moving-object interception rather than fine maintenance manipulation or physical-response tuning.
